title: Minimum Cost to Make at Least One Valid Path in a Grid
statement:
Given an `m x n` grid. Each cell of the grid has a sign pointing to the next cell you should visit if you are currently in this cell. The sign of `grid[i][j]` can be:
- 1 (Right)
- 2 (Left)
- 3 (Down)
- 4 (Up)
You can modify the sign on a cell to any other sign at a cost of `1`.
Return the minimum cost to make the grid have at least one valid path from the upper left cell `(0, 0)` to the bottom right cell `(m - 1, n - 1)`.
inputFormat:
Line 1: two integers m and n.
Next m lines: n space-separated integers.

examples.explanation: Modify signs at (0,3), (1,0), (2,3) to point appropriately to form a path.

m, n = map(int, input().split())
